description: This script generates an HTML documentation page for error conditions by loading error data from a JSON file, processing it, and creating an HTML table with error details and sub-conditions.

methods.name: assemble_message
methods.description: Assembles and formats error messages, converting HTML tags to markdown.

methods.name: load_error_conditions
methods.description: Loads and processes error condition data from a JSON file, filtering out legacy and internal errors.

methods.name: anchor_name
methods.description: Generates URL-friendly anchor names for error conditions and sub-conditions.

methods.name: generate_doc_rows
methods.description: Creates HTML table rows for each error condition and its sub-conditions.

methods.name: generate_doc_table
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML table for all error conditions.
